movies.description: A team of explorers travel through a wormhole in space in an attempt to ensure humanity's survival.
A fictional story about two legendary revolutionaries and their journey away from home before they started fighting for their country in the 1920s.
When Shiva, the son of Bahubali, learns about his heritage, he begins to look for answers to avenge his father's death.
A fierce crime drama following an enigmatic underworld figure seeking vengeance and justice.
A romantic horror comedy that follows an adventurous protagonist in an ancient enigmatic royal palace.
A fairy tale for grown-ups set against the backdrop of the high-stakes international cartel.
Jake Sully lives with his newfound family formed on the extrasolar moon Pandora. Once a familiar threat returns, Jake must work with Neytiri.
The deadly journey of Ronnie as he faces new lethal adversaries in high-octane martial arts warfare.
An epic biographical historical saga chronicling the valiant life and conquests of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj.
An epic cinematic adaptation of the ancient Sanskrit legend following Lord Rama's righteous quest, valor, and devotion.
Pushpa Raj expands his formidable red sandalwood empire facing intense retribution from SP Bhanwar Singh Shekhawat.
In a dystopian post-apocalyptic future, immortal warriors clash in an epic battle between cosmic forces of destiny and tyranny.
Wade Wilson and a brooding Wolverine team up across the multiverse in an explosive, irreverent superhero adventure.
Paul Atreides unites with Chani and the Fremen while seeking revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family.
Years after witnessing the death of Maximus, Lucius enters the Colosseum to fight for the future and glory of Rome.
The gripping biographical story of American scientist J. Robert Oppenheimer and his role in the development of the atomic bomb.

reviews.comment: Incredible action sequences and great background score!
